_description: POST /api/agents/prompt — Creates a prompt agent with a Bing Custom Search tool scoped to a specific search instance.
_notes: connectionName must match a connection listed by GET /api/connections?type=BingGrounding (or APIKey).
instanceName is the Bing Custom Search instance name from portal.azure.com.
market, count, and freshness are optional.
instructions: You are a support agent. Use the custom search to find answers in the company knowledge base.
description: Agent scoped to a Bing Custom Search instance.
